title: PO assertions are qualified before line reconciliation
oracle: Eligibility is retained per assertion, assertion replays preserve PO-line identity, future or otherwise ineligible assertions never enter totals through a shared line ID, and multiple eligible assertions for one line abstain as competing versions.
known_bad: Restore line-keyed eligibility lookup, omit PO-line identity from assertion replay identity, and disable competing-line reconciliation so aliased, duplicate, and future assertions can be aggregated.
prevention: executable duplicate and future assertion oracles
